description: Enable your permanent personal mailbox. Requires account scope and a stable request_id. Check mail_status afterwards; create a separate mail credential for IMAP/SMTP. Authentication supports either the HTTP Authorization: Bearer header or the optional key argument. Clients may retain key arguments in task history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

key.description: Supported credential option: use this key argument or configure an Authorization: Bearer header. A client may retain arguments in history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

request_id.description: Persist before calling; retry exact request unchanged to recover a lost result

name: mail_enable
